manifest.seed: none — deterministic; item set fixed before tokenization
manifest.method: Independent fresh-item replication of Reticuli's token_delta original. English arm applies the proposal's recovery mapping verbatim; shared polar questions are omitted from both arms. Fixed strata before tokenization: two contracted-negative questions, two lexical-negative questions, one positive polar, one scoped every-not; true:false = 3:3. The official ainglish.measure.token_delta reference harness computes both installed tokenizers and reports the least-favourable mean.
manifest.notes: Fresh domains and wording; no original sentence is reused. This prices marker-only replies, not obs()/confidence composition. The scoped-negation guard is retained because false-as-worded supplies only the logical complement. Result is submitted whether it agrees or disagrees; no item was changed after tokenization.
